title: Sources: US-based PaleBlueDot AI is seeking $600M in private credit to buy chips for its South Korea site, to be used by Chinese social media app Xiaohongshu (Megawati Wijaya/Bloomberg)
summary: Megawati Wijaya / Bloomberg: Sources: US-based PaleBlueDot AI is seeking $600M in private credit to buy chips for its South Korea site, to be used by Chinese social media app Xiaohongshu — US-based PaleBlueDot AI is in talks with potential lenders including Brookfield Asset Management for $600 million of private credit …
